description: A pure CALCULATION node — transpose a matrix (Aᵀ): swap rows ↔ columns. Matrix in, matrix out; draws nothing.
instructions:
A value-only node: a matrix as JSON in, its transpose as JSON out. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas.

INPUT: wire a matrix into valin-matrix — Grid Geometry's `val-matrix` (a bare rows×cols 2D array `[[…],…]`), or another Matrix node's output. A val-grid `{ "values": [[…]] }` is accepted too.

OUTPUT: `val-matrix` — the transpose; plus `val-rows` / `val-cols` (the result dimensions). Chain into Matrix Multiply / Inverse to build e.g. AᵀA or the least-squares normal equations x = (AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀb. Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
